build_uva_offload_config: build a UVAOffloadConfig instance to configure zero-copy CPU offloading with specified GB and parameter filters
build_prefetch_offload_config: build a PrefetchOffloadConfig instance to configure async prefetch-based layer offloading with group and step parameters
build_offload_config: build an OffloadConfig instance to configure model weight offloading with uva or prefetch backend selection
test_offload_validation: test the OffloadConfig model validator to verify offload_num_in_group and offload_prefetch_step constraints
compute_offload_hash: compute a hash string from OffloadConfig to uniquely identify all offload settings for compilation caching
